So what does the assignment look like? So
what we've built is a network simulator.

The networks are built up of things called

And the first three assignments are more

implementation must do. First assignment,

you just have to get the packets across.
Second assignment, you have to get as many
packets across as possible. It has to

how to better service your users. The next
two assignments are more fun.

So each of you will control a subnetwork.
It's called an autonomous system, is what
we call it in network parlance, AS.

So each of your code will be installed on

your job is to provide the best
